server/store.mjs: Store.applyGeneration(id, expectedVersion, sceneId, slotId) -> {job, episode} (existing synchronous instance method)

implemented: Only applyGeneration, its imports and a private file-verification helper were changed. Other Store behavior is unchanged.
Before episode/history/job/event writes, require a completed output matching the registered upload ID, job ID, URL, SHA-256, byte size, media type and kind.
Validate the registered UUID filename and exact local upload URL; reject path traversal, redirected upload roots, symlinks, missing files and non-regular files with 409.
Require a positive registered byte size no larger than the existing 100 MiB generation limit; rehash actual bytes through a 64 KiB buffer and reject reads exceeding the registered size.
Check the opened descriptor and path identity, size and timestamps before/after reading, and compare the actual SHA-256 with the registered completed output.
Retain synchronous API, existing transaction rollback, expectedVersion/scene/slot guards, generated illustration source metadata and immutable versioned history. No rights records are fabricated.

verification.failure: Missing expected exception: same-length changed bytes were accepted instead of a 409.

verification.result: Tampering rejects before episode/source/history/job-applied mutation; valid generation apply, stale version reconciliation, audit rollback, real PNG/video probing and HEVC normalization/reapply remain passing.
